digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven development loop lacks aggregation and historical trending visibility; no queries exist for code-health movement or gate effectiveness across time ranges
Tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug outcome classification) leave no durable trace in the event store and cannot be derived structurally from existing events
Passive instrumentation via blame-derivation and gate-sidecar ERROR outcomes must capture these blindspots without new manual agent commands or self-reported data
Bug-close UX must remain flat: replace required free-text reason with bounded close_class enum, not add to the argument count
Auto-derived caused_by edges must bypass closed-source guards by writing directly via _write_link_event after STATUS commit, since the bug source is already closed
Snapshot storage must use git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson path, not gitignored reports/, to ensure going-forward metric series persist
